text:
Maya R.: Quick plan: a 3-email 'Launchpad Accelerator' drip for mid-funnel leads who opened the benchmark but didn't register. Goal: webinar regs + demo bookings. Window 8 days.

Omar V.: Segment: engaged (clicked benchmark), warm (opened), cold (no click but recent visit). Tailor first line per seg.

Zoe H.: Subjects A/B: 'Benchmarks + playbook inside' vs 'See inference costs & wins' — run 50/50. Small exploratory cell 5% for urgency variant 'Seats filling fast'.

Tess (mail-bot): Draft campaign saved launchpad_3102. UTMs: utm_source=newsletter, utm_campaign=launchpad_3102, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Suppress_on=registered,downloaded.

Aaron P.: Cadence T0 invite + ebook, T+3 reminder to register, T+7 last-chance with scheduler link. Send window 10am local, throttle 3000/hr. If user books, suppress remaining sends.

Maya R.: Creative: hero chart, short 1-line per segment, include 1-line curl snippet. Zoe, upload assets by EOD. Tess, run seed tests 12h pre-send.

Tess (mail-bot): Preflight scheduled. Will post seed inboxing and spam score here. :robot_face:

Maya R.: Thanks team — target send next Wed. We'll watch CTR->reg conversion and iterate on Cold subject if open <12%.
